params.what_changed: On 2026-11-15 the owner moved the out-of-sample start from 2022-01-01 to 2025-01-01 (config/research.toml) and asked for the rejected PID configuration's performance on the released years, for reference. P10 had registered that the window stays shut on a rejection; that commitment is overridden by the owner for 2022-2024, which is now design data in any case.
params.verdict: unchanged — rejected. A reference reading cannot overturn it, and this one would not if it could.
params.configuration: trend 250, integral 120, derivative 10, kp 0.1, ki 0.1, kd 0.0, base 0.5, band 0.10
params.window: 2022-01-01 to 2024-12-31, simulated continuously from 2007; price frame cut at 2024-12-31 before anything was computed
params.reading: Over a round trip (-35% in 2022, +67% in 2023) the rule returned about what a fixed half position did: +18.2% against +16.2%, with the same drawdown and the same Sharpe. It lost less than the fixed half in 2022 while holding MORE (66% average), because it added late in the decline, and it gave up five points to the fixed half in 2023 by holding 38% through the rebound. Against holding the fund it kept four fifths of the return with a little over half the drawdown, which is what holding half does.
params.not_opened: 2025 onward. It is the test window for the next registration (P11) and stays shut for this rule until that test is recorded.
